_comment: Car classes. mass in kg, radius in metres. frictionMultiplier scales the surface friction; curlResponse scales how sharply spin bends the path (the player has no control that asks for spin - see ADR-011 - but the engine keeps it). Radii doubled on the owner's instruction after two rounds of play-test feedback that the pieces read too small on a phone. Mass left alone on purpose: size and weight are separate balance levers.
